tools.name: search_prior_art
tools.description: Ranked list of closest matching patents with claim-overlap summary for an invention description.

tools.name: get_patent_detail
tools.description: Full claims, citations, family, assignee, and status for a given patent ID.

tools.name: compare_claims
tools.description: Element-by-element comparison of an invention description against a patent's claims.

tools.name: landscape_summary
tools.description: Aggregate statistics (top assignees, filing-year trend, top CPC classes) over a representative sample of US patents matching a technology area, with a short narrative over those numbers. Statistics are computed deterministically in code, not estimated by the model. US coverage only (PatentsView/ODP)

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Records whether a prior tool response (identified by its request_id) was helpful, plus an optional comment.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Starts a Stripe Checkout session to upgrade this account (the one already authenticated on this connection) to Pay-as-you-go or Subscription. Returns a checkout_url to open in a browser; nothing changes until payment completes.

tools.name: create_scan_report
tools.description: Packages the findings from a patent_scan session into a paid ($299 one-time) Word document — pass every candidate mechanism found (with its search_prior_art/compare_claims results) as `candidates`. Returns checkout_url if payment is needed first (call this same tool again with the same candidates af

tools.name: regenerate_api_key
tools.description: Issues a brand-new API key for this account and permanently invalidates the current one. IMPORTANT, irreversible tradeoff: signing in again (GitHub, Google, Microsoft, or Clio) will no longer recover this account afterward — only use this when the caller has explicitly confirmed they understand that

tools.name: create_org
tools.description: Creates a team/org (a Patlas account shared by multiple people, one flat bill) owned by the calling account, and returns a checkout_url to open in a browser to pay for it. The org isn't active until payment completes.

tools.name: invite_org_member
tools.description: Owner-only. Generates a one-time invite link (valid 24h) to share with someone you want to add to your team — they open it in a browser, sign in, and accept.

tools.name: remove_org_member
tools.description: Owner-only. Removes a member from your team by their user id (see get_org_status for the list) — their access to team tools/limits is revoked immediately, but their own personal Patlas account is unaffected.

tools.name: get_org_status
tools.description: Returns the calling account's team (if any): name, status, seat usage, your role, and the member list.

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Watches a technology area (payg/subscription/team only, up to 5 per account) — checked once a day, posting a JSON payload to the given HTTPS webhook URL whenever new matching US patent filings appear. US coverage only (PatentsView/ODP).

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: Lists the calling account's active technology-area watches (see create_watch).

tools.name: delete_watch
tools.description: Permanently stops a watch by its watch_id (see list_watches).
